title: Spot the Mistake: Safe Charger
style_prompt: warm polished 3D animated children's educational film, fictional Indian characters, clean Indian home interior, clear soft lighting, simple uncluttered composition, no writing, no caption, no logo, no watermark

scenes.label: CHARACTER REFERENCE
scenes.prompt: one fictional Indian schoolboy in a blue school uniform, full-body neutral pose, front three-quarter view, friendly expressive face, both hands visible, plain indoor background

scenes.label: 1. NOTICE THE HAZARD
scenes.prompt: isolated object close-up of one disconnected damaged mobile phone charging cable resting on a clean light wooden floor, visibly split insulation with a few exposed copper strands, the composition contains only the cable and floor

scenes.label: 2. STOP AND STEP BACK
scenes.prompt: the same schoolboy stands fully upright in a clean home doorway, both hands held safely behind his back, feet stationary, calm concerned expression, looking toward an object outside the frame, large open safety gap around him

scenes.label: 3. TELL AN ADULT
scenes.prompt: the same schoolboy stands upright in a clean home doorway and calmly tells his caring mother about something outside the frame, the mother listens attentively and reassuringly, both people are unharmed and keep their hands away from the unseen hazard
